name: fillet-a-corner-counts-the-corner
why: The count beside a treatment is what .expect({ count }) is pasted from, and for a .vertices(...) selection .expect counts corners. The reply used to say edges: 3, the edges meeting at the corner, so pasting it failed with "matched 1". One corner of a 20 mm cube rounded 2 mm: 8000 - 3 x 18 x (4 - pi) - (8 - 4/3 pi) = 7949.835 mm3, three quarter-round edges of 18 mm and an eighth of a sphere.
